scope: Bounded exact-recipient reconciliation that archives notifications no longer allowed by current privacy or source policy

canonical_plan_sync.follow_up: Synchronize the canonical plan without replacing unrelated concurrent task updates

policy.ownership_scope: exact non-nil tenant and recipient identities
policy.raw_scope: scan only non-archived notification rows owned by that exact recipient
policy.page_bound: 20 rows by default and 64 rows maximum
policy.ordering: created_at descending then notification id descending
policy.cursor: reuse the crate-private i1 inbox cursor with full timestamp seconds and nanoseconds plus non-nil UUID tie-breaker
policy.cursor_bound: non-empty control-free cursor capped at 128 bytes before parsing
policy.authorization_composition: reuse NotificationInboxOpenService for current recipient privacy and source target authorization
policy.archive_decision: archive only rows whose current open decision is unavailable
policy.archive_owner: persist through NotificationInboxStateService exact-recipient archive command
policy.timestamp_preservation: archive preserves existing seen_at and read_at values
policy.failure_progress: owner errors stop the page while earlier per-row archives remain durable and idempotent on restart
policy.transaction_boundary: no recipient policy or source provider call runs inside a notification database transaction
policy.response: return only scanned and archived counts plus continuation metadata
policy.delivery_boundary: reconciliation does not create or mutate delivery attempts

not_delivered: canonical unread counts and grouped inbox views
tenant-wide scheduled reconciliation and payload redaction
external inbox transport and UI adapters
search index SEO and deep-link migration
